title: Proposal for Age-based Only Benefits Irrespective of Income and Housing Type in Majulah Package
what_it_is: Proposal for Age-based Only Benefits Irrespective of Income and Housing Type in Majulah Package

sections.label: Majulah Package for young seniors
sections.summary: The Majulah Package will support lower-income young seniors in their 50s and early 60s, with details announced in Budget 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The key segments we want to help are the “young seniors” who are now in their 50s and early 60s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: They have benefited from Singapore’s economic growth and our investments in education, healthcare and social security.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Hence, we have designed the Majulah Package to provide more support to those with lower incomes and less wealth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will therefore consider these suggestions by Ms Phua and Mr Edward Chia, as we finalise the parameters of the Majulah Package.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Details on the Majulah Package will be announced in Budget 2024.

sections.label: Call to redesign Majulah Package
sections.summary: A call was made to MOF to design the Majulah Package like the inclusive Merdeka and Pioneer Packages, with cash payouts and subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: And I can understand why because the state has limited resources.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: But like what Senior Minister of State just mentioned, there are some common needs amongst people of this age group, and therefore, I want to make a call to MOF to design the Majulah Package to be more like the Merdeka and the Pioneer Packages, which are very well designed and very inclusive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: It had overall cash payouts, MediSave top-ups, outpatient subsidies and even health screening.
